description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCache' that manages cache operations such as retrieving, removing, and clearing caches for entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with utility cache classes and delegator factories to handle cache naming and cache instance management.

classes.name: AbstractCache
classes.description: An abstract class providing cache management functionalities for entities, including cache retrieval, removal, and creation, with support for cache naming conventions.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns a Delegator instance based on the delegator name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the cache associated with a specific entity name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all caches that start with the cache name prefix.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for cache names.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefixes
methods.description: Returns an array of cache name prefix patterns.

methods.name: getCacheName
methods.description: Constructs the cache name for a specific entity.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns an array of cache name patterns for a specific entity.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cache for a specific entity.

methods.name: getOrCreateCache
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cache or creates a new one for a specific entity.
